Development Group

# Commissioner Development Group

The Commissioner Development Group is responsible for development and
maintenance of national training  and onboarding materials and processes that
enable commissioners to ensure that every member of Scouting America has a
great Scouting experience.

_**Curriculum Review Team  
**_ The Curriculum Review Team coordinates a team of subject matter experts
that develop and maintain both web-based and instructor-led training for
commissioners.
